steps.body: Speed comes from recall, not rushing: a remembered fact needs no working out.
steps.narration: Speed comes from recall, not rushing: a remembered fact needs no working out.

widget.prompt: Count the squares in this 5 by 7 array.

commonCounts.feedback: That adds 5 and 7 rather than counting the squares.
That counts one row of the five.

widget.lowFeedback: Keep counting — every square in all 5 rows belongs to the total.
widget.highFeedback: The grid holds only 35 squares; counting past that means a square was counted twice.

predict.prompt: Which facts deserve the most practice?

options.label: The ones that still need working out

predict.reveal: Practice is worth most where recall is slowest. Facts already automatic gain little from repetition.

misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines g3m recall speed.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: 8 × 7 = 56 — one of the table facts worth knowing on sight.

commonErrors.feedback: That is 8 short of the product — one whole group of 8 is missing.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Skip-count by 7, 8 times — or lean on a fact you already know and adjust.
